title: mentha jurana
intro: Mentha jurana, commonly known as Indian pennywort or Vahnu, is a type of plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve cognitive function, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in Mentha jurana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-anxiety, anti-depressant, and anti-epileptic effects. The plant's leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, digestive issues, and skin problems.
